name: ambush-streams
description: Create, review, and manage personalized Ambush news streams from Codex.

interface.longDescription: Turn a plain-language monitoring request into an Ambush stream, review existing streams and their emissions, update prompts or names, and pause, resume, or delete streams without leaving Codex.
defaultPrompt: List my Ambush streams and summarize their status.
Create a stream that monitors a topic for me.
Show the latest emissions from one of my streams.
